programme.title: Likteņa līdumnieki
programme.desc: "Likteņa līdumnieki'" ir vienas dzimtas – Nārbuļu ģimenes – vēsture laikposmā no 1885. gada, kad barons izprecina pavesto istabmeitu, pūrā dodot zemi, cauri visiem liktenīgajiem 20. gadsimta notikumiem līdz pat 1995. gadam. Ne velti "Likteņa līdumniekus" dēvējam par latviešu sāgu – tas ir stāsts par stipriem cilvēkiem, pretrunīgiem, spītīgiem, kaislīgiem, tikpat neaprēķināmiem kā zeme, kas tos radījusi, ar gaišām, pašapziņas pilnām sejām, kādas ir mūsu senčiem vecos fotogrāfiju albumos. Tetraloģijas scenārija autore ir Māra Svīre (daudzu latviešu filmu scenāriju autore, t. sk. filmas "Limuzīns Jāņu nakts krāsā" scenārija autore), bet literāro pamatu veido Vladimira Kaijaka romāna četras daļas: "Enijas bize", "Zem Marsa debesīm", "Nārbuļu dēli" un "Mantinieki". Videofilmā filmējušies 189 aktieri un ļoti daudz masu skatu dalībnieku.

programme.title: Divi vienā
programme.desc: Notiek gatavošanās konkursam "Ideālā ģimene". Dāvids nonāk dilemmas priekšā, ar kuru no meitenēm braukt uz koncertu Tallinā – ar Samantu vai Martu. Kristapam arvien vairāk iepatīkas Rūta. Anete un Lauris melo viens otram un izliekas, ka viņiem ir ideāla saskaņa ar otrajām pusītēm – Oskaru un Kristīni. Dāvids pirmo reizi dzīvē priecājas par skandālu ar neapmierinātu klientu. Astrīda atklāj Kristapa noslēpumu un līdz ar to apdraud konkursa norisi.

programme.title: Divi vienā
programme.desc: Iemīļoti pašmāju aktieri un pieredzējusī režisore Inta Gorodecka ir pašmāju seriāla "Divi vienā" kodols. Stāsta centrā ir divas ģimenes – Krūmiņu un Abuladžu. Emīlija Krūmiņa un Veronika Abuladze pirms daudziem gadiem bijušas labākās draudzenes, taču strīds temperamentīgā gruzīna Zuraba dēļ, kuru Veronika Emīlijai "nocēlusi", draudzību izjaucis. Nu notikusi sakritība – abām ģimenēm nākas dalīt vienu māju, jo Krūmiņu ģimene no laukiem pārvākusies dzīvot tuvāk pilsētai un iekārtojusies Zuraba un Veronikas apdzīvotās dvīņu mājas otrajā pusē. Anete ir Abuladžu, bet Lauris – Krūmiņu atvase. Abi dažādu iemeslu dēļ vairs nedzīvo kopā ar saviem dzīvesbiedriem un, kļūstot par kaimiņiem, viens otrā rada interesi.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Uz Karību jūras salu tiek nosūtīts britu policists Ričards Pūls atšķetināt sava amata brāļa slepkavību. Kā ar stērķeli iestīvinātais, pat lielākajā karstumā nešķiroties no žaketes, īpatnējais brits Ričards ir gluži vai pārdabiski vērīgs un spēj aizrakties līdz patiesībai, pat ja izmeklēšana ir nonākusi pilnīgā strupceļā.

programme.title: Nāve paradīzē
programme.desc: Grupa putnu vērotāju ieradušies salā, lai pētītu retos zaļos papagaiļus. Viens no viņiem, Marks Talbots, tiek nogalināts ar medību nazi, kas pieder viņam pašam. Talbots nebija iemīļots grupas biedrs, tādēļ domstarpību dēļ krīt aizdomas uz grupas dalībniekiem. Dīvainākais ir tas, ka Marks no grupas redzesloka pazuda vien uz pāris sekundēm…

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Komanda izveido vadības punktu pie Klāras skolas, lai vāktu liecības Klāras lietā, un uzzina jaunu informāciju. Stefans dusmojas, ka Dibo bijusi taisnība un iecirkņa darbinieki ir Lorāna Klutjē marionetes. Gabriela pieņem lēmumu - neviens no 31. iecirkņa vairs nedrīkst komunicēt ar Lorānu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Pēc lietu pārskatīšanas par iecirkņa prioritāti kļūst rakstnieces Leas Bordāžas lieta, ir jau pirmais aizdomās turamais - Filips Budriā. Gabriela izsaka nopietnus draudus Melisai Korbejai. Noelija, Bruno un Floransa dodas sagūstīt Filipu, bet notiek negaidīts pavērsiens.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Tiek apspriesta Lorāna drauga Maksima Blē iesaiste iecirkņa izmeklēšanās, jo viņš veiksmīgi palīdzēja Filipa Budriā aizturēšanas operācijā. Atgriežas Viržīnija – satraukta un bez naudas. Patriks un Bruno nopratina Filipu, izrādās, ka viņa noziedzīgajam mērķim – astoņām sievietēm – joprojām draud briesmas.

programme.title: Dubultais kritiens
programme.desc: Dokumentālā filma stāsta par Viktoriju Siljersu, kura pēc otrā bērna piedzimšanas atgriezās pie sava iemīļotā hobija – izpletņlēkšanas. Lēciena laikā izpletnis neatvērās, bet Viktorija brīnumainā kārtā izdzīvoja pēc kritiena no 1200 metru augstuma. Policija sāka izmeklēt notikušo, un drīz kļuva skaidrs, ka tas nebija negadījums. Izmeklētāji atklāja, ka Viktorijas vīrs viņu krāpa, taču tā bija tikai aisberga redzamā puse. Tomēr izmeklēšanas gaitā Viktorija nostājās vīra pusē.

programme.title: Midsomeras slepkavības
programme.desc: Detektīvs Toms Bārnabijs ir pacietīgs un metodisks izmeklētājs. Viņš saprot, ka noziegumiem mazā pilsētiņā vienmēr būs sociāls raksturs, tamdēļ svarīgi izprast tās iedzīvotāju attiecības. Tikai un vienīgi viņš spēj pamanīt neskaidrus mājienus un sadzīt pēdas viltīgam slepkavam brīdī, kad nupat, šķiet, tas izbēgs nesodīts. Kad Toms Bārnabijs atgriežas mājās, viņš ir mīlošs vīrs un tēvs, tomēr, neskatoties uz to, detektīvs viņā nekad nesnauž. Citreiz vistrāpīgākās atklāsmes rodas tieši pie brokastu galda! Seriāls "Midsomeras slepkavības" ieturēts vislabākajās britu klasiskā detektīva tradīcijās: virkne aizdomās turamo, sajauktas pēdas, mīklaini mājieni, neizprotami motīvi un iespēja skatītājam pašam minēt, kurš šoreiz būs vainīgais. Seriāls veiksmīgi izrādīts teju visās Eiropas valstīs, kā arī ASV, Kanādā, Dienvidāfrikā un Tuvajos Austrumos, kopumā tas tiek uzņemts jau vairāk nekā 25 gadus.

programme.title: Viņpus paradīzei
programme.desc: Seriāls ir BBC veidota krimināldrāma, kas atvasināta no seriāla "Nāve paradīzē" sižeta līnijas. Stāsts vēsta par detektīvu inspektoru Hamfriju Gudmenu, kurš pametis Karību salu Sentmerī, lai būtu kopā ar Martu Loidu. Kad abi saderinājušies, viņi pārceļas uz Martas dzimto pilsētu Šiptonebotu, kas atrodas Devonā. Hamfrijs sāk darbu vietējā policijas iecirknī. Viņš spēj atstāt spilgtu iespaidu uz vietējiem policistiem: seržanti Esteri Viljamsu, konsteblu Kelbiju Hārtfordu un biroja vadītāju Margo Mārtinsu. Visi ir pārsteigti par jaunā detektīva darba metodēm, kuras izrādās visai iedarbīgas.

programme.title: Melnais saraksts
programme.desc: Kritiķu un skatītāju iemīļots kriminālseriāls. Tā darbība sākas dienā, kad darbu FIB galvenajā birojā Vašingtonā uzsāk jauna profilētāja Elizabete Kīna. Tajā pašā rītā tur ierodas viens no FIB meklētākajiem noziedzniekiem, Reimonds "Reds" Redingtons, un labprātīgi ļauj sevi notvert. Reds palīdz FIB sagūstīt citu bīstamu noziedznieku un novērst uzbrukumu civiliedzīvotājiem. Viņš paziņo, ka viņam esot vesels saraksts un informācija par tādiem noziedzniekiem un teroristiem, par kuru esamību FIB pat nenojauš. Reds ir gatavs sadarboties ar vienu savādu noteikumu – viņš runās tikai ar Elizabeti. Tā sākas īpašas attiecības, kuru īstā daba un iemesls ir zināmi tikai Redingtonam. Lai gan pamatā seriāla darbība norit ASV, tas aizved arī uz dažādām eksotiskām vietām visā pasaulē un ļauj ieskatīties kriminālajā pasaulē. Dažādiem apbalvojumiem vairāku gadu laikā izvirzīti seriāla specefektu veidotāji, kaskadieri un muzikālais noformējums.

programme.title: Pārtikas revidents
programme.desc: "Pārtikas revidents" ir analītisks raidījums, kas pēta veikalu plauktos un tirgū pieejamās pārtikas izcelsmi, saturu un cenu atšķirību, katrā raidījumā īpašu uzmanību veltot kādam produktam. Kas patiesībā ir šī produkta sastāvā? Kas ir izplatītākie mīti par to, un vai tie ir patiesi? Kur un kā šis pārtikas produkts tiek radīts? Vai cena vienmēr nozīmē kvalitāti? Šie ir tikai daži no jautājumiem, uz kuriem tiek meklētas atbildes. Raidījuma idejas autors ir žurnālists un raidījuma "Aizliegtais Paņēmiens" vadītājs Guntis Bojārs, vadītāja – Ieva Strazdiņa. Tā vienlaikus ir arī Ievas Strazdiņas debija LTV žurnālistu komandā. Raidījumā aktīvi darbosies arī žurnālistes Krista Tuča, Lauma Krastiņa un Liena Skadiņa.

programme.title: Ararata ēnā. Armēnija
programme.desc: Esam ieradušies mazākajā no Kaukāza valstīm - Armēnijā. Raidījuma vadītāji parādīs valsti no visdažādākajiem aspektiem.

programme.title: Ararata ēnā. Armēnija
programme.desc: Esam ieradušies mazākajā no Kaukāza valstīm - Armēnijā. Raidījuma vadītāji parādīs valsti no visdažādākajiem aspektiem.

programme.title: VIII Ziemeļu un Baltijas valstu dziesmu svētki
programme.desc: Atzīmējot tradīcijas 20. gadskārtu, 2015. gadā Rīgā un Latvijas novados notika VIII Ziemeļu un Baltijas valstu Dziesmu svētki .

programme.title: Aculiecinieks
programme.desc: 13 minūšu gari televīzijas stāsti vēsta par notikumiem un Latvijā īpašiem cilvēkiem, aptverot vēsturiskus, zinātnes, izglītības, pilsētas, lauku un daudzus citus tematus.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: Globalizācijas un mēs
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Ražots Vācijā
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle žurnāls.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Dzintaru prospektā Jūrmalā 1976. gadā tika uzcelta viena no nozīmīgākajām modernās kustības ēkām Latvijā - spēļu un atrakciju pils "Daile". Šogad ēkas arhitektu Edgaru Šēnbergu pieminam 100. gadskārtā, bet atrakciju pili diemžēl varam apskatīt tikai kino kadros un maketā, jo būve 21. gadsimta sākumā tika nojaukta. Skatoties pirms 12 gadiem filmēto ielu, meklēsim plusus un mīnusus pilsētas vaibstos. Būs arī jaunatklājumi, jo reti kurš vairs zina, kur atradās Avotu stacija, kur - Latvijas kultūrai tik nozīmīgā Grosvaldu vasarnīca vai izcilā arhitekta Konstantīna Pēkšēna vasarnīca.

programme.title: Ielas garumā
programme.desc: Pirms 12 gadiem "Ielas garumā" pirmoreiz aizbraucām uz Malēniju un bijām pārsteigti par Alūksnes kultūrvēsturisko un ainavisko bagātību un alūksniešu vitalitāti. Taču, kā izrādās, alūksniešiem jau tad bija idejas, kā atjaunot kultūras pieminekļus un padarīt pilsētu vēl pievilcīgāku. Labās ziņas no Alūksnes mudināja turp doties arī mūsu raidījuma jubilejas gadā, lai apskatītos, kā pārvērtusies Alūksnes Jaunā pils un parks, Alūksnes ezers un Pilssala. Taču atklājām arī jaunas ielas un namus, par ko stāstīsim raidījumā. Raidījuma arhīvā REplay.lv var atrast arī trīs 2011. gadā tapušos "Ielas garumā" stāstus no Alūksnes.

programme.title: Tutas Lietas
programme.desc: Cik rokai ir pirkstu? Kā pagatavot kūku no smiltīm? Un kā skan bungas? Izzinot sevi un pasauli, bērniem ir daudz jautājumu. "Tutas lietas" ir video stāstu sērija bērniem vecumā no viena līdz pieciem gadiem, ko žurnāliste un raidījumu vadītāja Marta Selecka radījusi kopā ar domubiedriem – mazu bērnu vecākiem no kino un TV profesionāļu vides. Raidījuma būtība – tas ir mīļš un izglītojošs ekrāna saturs pašiem mazākajiem, viņiem saprotamā valodā par interesantām un noderīgām tēmām. Raidījuma galvenā varone ir jaukā meitene, bērnu draudzene Tuta. Viņas lomā iejutusies aktrise un mamma Liene Sebre. Tuta mazajiem jautru rotaļu veidā māca pašus pirmos vārdus, krāsas, dziesmiņas un skaitļus. Kopā ar Tutu jaunas lietas bērniem apgūt palīdz arī draudzīgā un ziņkārīgā Lapsa. "Tutas lietu" stāstiņu kopējo konceptu veidojusi Marta Selecka, bet scenārijus sagatavojusi jaunā, talantīgā bērnu autore Inga Mastiņa. Bērniem saistošu radošu vizuālo noskaņu radījusi pieredzējusī dizainere Ilze Žūriņa-Šeibaka, bet Tutas dziesmas mūzikas autore un izpildītāja ir dziedātāja un komponiste Laura Polence. Tutas piedzīvojumus iemūžinājis operators Dāvis Doršs, bet projekta režiju un montāžu veidojusi Andra Doršs, kura par savu darbu Latvijas kino projektos ieguvusi arī Nacionālo kino balvu "Lielais Kristaps".

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Gudrs, vēl gudrāks
programme.desc: Kompetenti eksperti katrā spēlē sagatavos atbilstošus jautājumus konkrētai vecuma grupai. Jautājumi ietvers mācību vielu un sabiedriski aktuālas tēmas mūzikā, mākslā, vēsturē, politikā un citās jomās. Savus jautājumus spēles dalībniekiem gan atraktīvā video formātā, gan tiešraidē studijā, sagatavo arī sabiedrībā zināmi cilvēki – kultūras jomas pārstāvji, zinātnieki, sportisti, politiķi, mūziķi un citi.

programme.title: Aculiecinieks
programme.desc: 13 minūšu gari televīzijas stāsti vēsta par notikumiem un Latvijā īpašiem cilvēkiem, aptverot vēsturiskus, zinātnes, izglītības, pilsētas, lauku un daudzus citus tematus.

programme.title: Cilvēks.jpg
programme.desc: Lauris Zalāns un Nansija Garkalne! Lauris Zalāns kļuvis plaši atpazīstams pēc viņa publicētajiem videoklipiem sociālajos medijos "Instagram" un "TikTok". Viņš ir arī radio "TEV" ētera balss un pasākumu vadītājs. Nansija Garkalne aktīvi veido digitālo saturu un manāma vairākos televīzijas raidījumos, piemēram "Virtuve bez kāposta", "Ekvadora pa ekvatoru", "Pielaiko profesiju"... un, protams, vadot pasākumus! Šajā epizodē atklāsim nezināmus vārdus no Latvijas novadiem, kopā fanosim un radīsim saukļus, uzzināsim dalībnieku bailes, atklāsim mākslas talantus!

programme.title: Cilvēks.jpg
programme.desc: Šajā epizodē pie mums viesojas Edgars Fresh un Undīne Ozoliņa/Undixone. Abi šīs epizodes dalībnieki ir digitālā satura veidotāji. Edgars jeb Edgars Fresh publicē videoklipus - galvenokārt saistībā ar digitālajām tehnoloģijām - sociālajos medijos "YouTube", "TikTok" un "Instagram". Viņš ir arī izveidojis sociālo platformu digitālā satura veidotājiem un raidierakstu "Caffeine Creators". Undīne veido digitālo saturu, kas piesaista jauniešu auditoriju. Viņa ceļo, piedalās raidījumos un pasākumos. Kā abiem veiksies praktiskos un radošos pārbaudījumos, redzēsim raidījumā!

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Izmeklētāja Vera ir parasta sieviete neparastā amatā. Mācījusies no skarbākajām dzīves dienām, viņa saglabā optimistisku skatu uz pasauli. Viņai ir laba humora izjūta un viņa ir ļoti piezemēta – izmeklētājai nepiemīt ne kripatas uzpūtības, lai gan viņa var būt skarba pret padotajiem. Dziļi sirdī viņa slēpj gadiem ilgušu vientulību, taču ārēji to slēpj aiz skarbas ironijas maskas. Veras lomu atveido aktrise Brenda Bletina, kas ir vairākkārt nominēta Oskaram, tā skaitā par lomu Maika Lī filmā "Noslēpumi un meli", par kuru arī ieguvusi "Zelta Globusu".

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Vera izglābj vienpadsmitgadīgo Ādamu, kurš, kā izrādās, izbēdzis no savas mātes Mārgaretas slepkavas. Tomēr puisēns nespēj pastāstīt neko izmeklēšanai noderīgu, vien to, ka redzējis pāvus. Pierādījumi liecina, ka māte un dēls devušies uz Spāniju. Nozieguma vietā atrasts prāvs naudas žūksnis. Aizdomās par slepkavību tiek turēts mātes mīļākais Bobijs Salters, bet tad Veru pārsteidz mazais Ādams, kurš atpazīst tiesnesi Tiu Kārmaiklu kā ģimenes draudzeni, lai gan tiesnese apgalvo, ka Vaildus nepazīst.

programme.title: Vera
programme.desc: Dženija Listera ir teicama peldētāja, kurai patīk peldēt nevis baseinā, bet dabiskās ūdenstilpēs. Kad viņa tiek atrast mirusi pie upes, kļūst skaidrs, ka viņa nevarēja noslīkt. Dženija ir strādājusi par sociālo darbinieci. Visi viņu slavē par darbu. Viņas meita Hanna ir šokā par notikušo. Viņa ir pārliecināta, ka neviens nevarēja vēlēt mātei nāvi. Hannai ir tuvs draugs Saimons, kurš viņai palīdz pārciest grūto laiku. Izmeklēšanas pavedieni ved vairākos virzienos, kas saistīti ar Dženijas darbu, bet reizēm nav jāmeklē tik tālu.

programme.title: Pasaules kausa atlases spēle basketbolā. Studija
programme.desc: Pret Izraēlu jāspēlē Rīgā, un nākamās divas cīņas šajā atlases ciklā būs tikai novembra nogalē, savukārt pēdējās jau pēc Jaunā gada. Pirms pēdējās atlases kārtas Latvijai bija par vienu uzvaru vairāk nekā šāvakara pretiniekiem, taču galvenais būs noķert līderus mūsu grupā. Lai to izdarītu, šajās divās augusta spēlēs obligāti nepieciešamas uzvaras. Basketbola studijā pirms spēles runāsim par abu komandu sastāviem, tāpat par šonedēļ jau aizvadītajām pirmās kārtas spēlēm. Uzklausīsim arī pašus spēlētājus un trenerus.

programme.title: FIBA Pasaules kausa basketbolā Eiropas atlase. Latvija – Izraēla
programme.desc: Šī būs nozīmīga spēle Latvijas izlasei, pavisam noteikti bez Kristapa Porziņģa un Dāvja Bertāna. Šajās augusta spēlēs izlasei nepalīdzēs arī Rolands Šmits un Rodions Kurucs, treneri nav sastāvā iekļāvuši Artūru Kurucu un Andreju Gražuli, kuri nav optimālā formā. Par pretinieku sastāvu pagaidām grūti spriest, bet katrā ziņā viņiem nepalīdzēs NBA spēlētāji Deni Avdija un Bens Sarafs. Izraēla ir gana spēcīga komanda ar labiem spēlētājiem vai ikvienā postenī, kodolu veidos divu Telavivas komandu "Maccabi" un "Hapoel" pārstāvji. Mūsdienu basketbolā nevienu nav viegli uzvarēt, parasti cīņas šādu komandu starpā ir ļoti līdzīgas un daudz ko var izšķirt dažādas nianses. Vienmēr gan svarīga ir disciplīna un spēles plāna ievērošana, bet ir arī faktori, kurus grūti prognozēt, tostarp, kā sekmēsies ar metieniem. Izraēlas basketbolisti ir sīksti, atlētiski, labi cīnās zem groziem, un mūsējiem nebūs viegli pat ar visai lielo savu līdzjutēju atbalstu tribīnēs.

programme.title: Gorbačovs. Paradīze
programme.desc: "Gorbačovs. Paradīze" ir dokumentāla filma par izmaiņām, kuras, viena vīra izraisītas, atbalsojās visā pasaulē. Filmā atspoguļota tā vīra dzīve, kurš 20. gadsimtā izmainīja pasauli. Īso brīdi, kad Gorbačovs bija pie varas, iezīmēja viņa impērijas sabrukums. Viņš bija Atklātības (Glasnost) un Pārbūves (Perestroika) arhitekts. Šīs jaunās politikas sniedza Padomju Savienības pilsoņiem iespēju kļūt brīviem valstī, ko Ronalds Reigans sauca par "ļaunuma impēriju". Viņš nojauca Berlīnes mūri. Tomēr tajā pat laikā viņa valdības laikā notika avārija Černobiļas atomstacijā, un šis notikums tika noklusēts. Pilsoņi, kas pieprasīja Baltijas valstu neatkarību, gāja bojā. Kareivji, vicinot lāpstas, brutāli apspieda protestētājus Tbilisi. Padomju tanki brauca virsū mierīgajiem demonstrantiem Baku un nogalināja viņus. Padomju impērija sabruka viņa vadībā, un viņa paša cilvēki viņu nosoda. Nesot pagātnes nastu, šis vientuļais vecais vīrs dzīvo sava mūža pēdējās dienas tukšā namā kādā priekšpilsētā netālu no Maskavas.

programme.title: Nakts reiss
programme.desc: Londonas detektīve Hana Lī ir norīkota pavadīt doktoru Metjū Nolanu uz Pekinu, kur viņš tiek apsūdzēts smagā noziegumā. Taču 357. nakts reisā uz Ķīnu Hana saprot, ka šis uzdevums nebūt nebūs tik vienkāršs – lidojuma laikā viņa tiek ierauta sarežģītā sazvērestībā, kurā neko nevar uztvert par pašsaprotamu. Nolans apgalvo, ka ir nevainīgs, bet Hana apšauba visu, ko līdz šim zinājusi, un to, kas ir viņas patiesie sabiedrotie. Nezināmi ienaidnieki vēlas panākt, lai Nolans nekad nesasniegtu galamērķi, bet Hana kļūst par mērķi tiem, kuri vēlas noslēpt patiesību par Nolana pagātni. Spriedzei pieaugot, lidmašīnā parādās pirmās slepkavības, un Hana saprot, ka atklājumi, kas viņu sagaida, var maksāt gan viņas, gan Nolana dzīvību.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Komanda izveido vadības punktu pie Klāras skolas, lai vāktu liecības Klāras lietā, un uzzina jaunu informāciju. Stefans dusmojas, ka Dibo bijusi taisnība un iecirkņa darbinieki ir Lorāna Klutjē marionetes. Gabriela pieņem lēmumu - neviens no 31. iecirkņa vairs nedrīkst komunicēt ar Lorānu.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Pēc lietu pārskatīšanas par iecirkņa prioritāti kļūst rakstnieces Leas Bordāžas lieta, ir jau pirmais aizdomās turamais - Filips Budriā. Gabriela izsaka nopietnus draudus Melisai Korbejai. Noelija, Bruno un Floransa dodas sagūstīt Filipu, bet notiek negaidīts pavērsiens.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Seriāls "Policijas iecirknis 31" seko stāstam par detektīvseržanti Nadīnu Legrānu un viņas kolēģi Patriku Bisonē, kā arī citiem viņu biedriem policijas iecirknī, kur viņi sastopas ar ikdienas noziegumiem, kas notiek lielajās pilsētās: slepkavības, nolaupīšanas, ielaušanās, vardarbība ģimenē, narkotiku tirdzniecība, terorisms un daudz kas cits.

programme.title: Policijas iecirknis
programme.desc: Tiek apspriesta Lorāna drauga Maksima Blē iesaiste iecirkņa izmeklēšanās, jo viņš veiksmīgi palīdzēja Filipa Budriā aizturēšanas operācijā. Atgriežas Viržīnija – satraukta un bez naudas. Patriks un Bruno nopratina Filipu, izrādās, ka viņa noziedzīgajam mērķim – astoņām sievietēm – joprojām draud briesmas.

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: "Province" – tie ir valsts bēniņi. Tā ir kā savdabīga pasaule, kam ikdienā mēs, viesistabu un guļamistabu apdzīvotāji, nepievēršam daudz uzmanības. Laiks šeit rit pēc citiem likumiem. Tas atnāk gandrīz tikpat ātri, bet aiziet lēnāk un ilgāk kavējas. Katrai valstij un tautai ir vajadzīgi savi bēniņi. Tie dod kādu īpašu stabilitāti, kas nekā citādi nav iegūstama. Bēniņu lielākā bagātība ir to spēja būt citādiem…

programme.title: Mani hiti
programme.desc: "MyHits TV" atskaņo gan pašmāju, gan ārzemju labākos un karstākos šībrīža hitus – rūpīgi atlasīti TOP 40 formāta ritmi jūsu ekrānā!

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur.

programme.title: Genoa Bridge Disaster
programme.desc: The special tells the story of the tragic collapse of Morandi's bridge in Genova, in which 43 people lost their lives. The story begins with a chronological re-enactment of the disaster, cut into several scenes displaying critical moments in the unfolding of the collapse. Through the testimonies of the survivors, the show "winds back" the scenes to analyse the causes and events leading up to the tragedy. It ends with the last testimonies of those affected by the catastrophe, followed by a debate on the technological advances made to prevent similar disasters from happening again.

programme.title: Notre Dame: Race Against the Inferno
programme.desc: On 15th April 2019, during Holy Monday Mass, the world's most famous cathedral caught fire. Notre-Dame de Paris was ablaze in minutes, as an epic battle unfolded for heroic French firefighters. Under the gaze of the world's media, they fought the inferno for more than 15 hours. Exclusive footage and interviews bring vividly to life the moment-by-moment courage of the Paris fire and police services, as they put their lives on the line to save this historic building.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Construction cranes are towers in the sky - except when they collapse. Our first story examines three disasters in Seattle, Manhattan and Bangkok. Three disasters: three different reasons for collapse. We examine what went wrong. The Artz Pedregal Mall in Mexico City had only been open a few months before the cantilevered section of the structure came crashing to the street below. How could a brand new building fail so dramatically? What's so precarious about cantilever designs?

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: On 3rd October 1993, US soldiers from the elite units of the U.S. Army's Rangers and Delta Force stormed a building near the in Mogadishu, Somalia, to capture key lieutenants in warlord Mohamed Farrah Aidid's clan. What should have been a simple snatch and grab operation lasting under an hour, turned into a day and night battle that resulted in the deaths of 18 Rangers and an estimated 500 to 1,000 Somali civilians.

programme.title: Seconds from Disaster
programme.desc: Over two days in spring of 1996, 8 climbers died on the descent from Mount Everest. A fierce storm, hubris and ambition and a series of errors contributed to make this the deadliest day in the history of the mountain. On May 10th two competing commercial guided expeditions were making the ascent to Everest. Adventure Consultants led by New Zealand climbing veteran Rob Hall and Mountain Madness led by accomplished American climber Scott Fischer led clients, each of whom paid up to $65,000, to summit the peak. Dr Jeremy Windsor a leading expert on altitude will examine the dangers posed by climbing at such a high altitude where oxygen in the air is three times less than sea level, and reveals weather data that may have uniquely contributed to the tragedy

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The station is undergoing an impressive transformation, with the old railway bridge being replaced by a gigantic steel structure. Superintendent Leon faces a huge challenge in this complex operation. Security & Services staff accompany two undocumented migrants to the Asylum Seekers Application Centre, while Gusta helps travelers recover lost property in the Lost & Found department.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Secrets of Area
programme.desc: Area 51 is renowned for being one of the most top secret sites on earth. After years shrouded in mystery, the CIA released classified information about the missions that took place in years past. This 1 hour special tells the unique perspective of the CIA agents who worked hard to cover up years of secret missions and the employees who worked inside Area 51. What really happens at the most secret military base in the world?

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: Area 51, a military outpost in the desert, shrouded in secrecy for decades, has long been the focus of many Unidentified Aerial Phenomena, or "UAP" rumors. A pop culture phenomenon, Area 51 prompted one Facebook group to suggest storming the facility in search for answers. Civilian UAP groups continue making progress in providing those answers. For the first time since 1969, Congress questions high level officials in the Pentagon on UAPs.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: From a 1986 sighting over Alaska by Japanese Airline pilots, to a 1997 UAP sighting over Phoenix Arizona and a flying disc over the Chicago O'Hare airport in 2008, hundreds of witnesses come forward without any official feedback from the US government. Years later many of the pilots and government officials who witnessed these sightings come together for the first time to share their story in a 2007 press conference.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Master mechanics Fuzz Townshend and parts-blagging petrol head Tim Shaw are back for a brand new season of the fan favourite show Car S.O.S. The comedy duo have their work-cut out as they embark on more undercover missions rescuing classic cars and returning them in a surprise reveal to their much deserving owners. This season starts with a exhaust bang, as Tim and Fuzz are on a special mission to rescue a unique classic racing car and reunite it with a true racing legend...Sir Stirling Moss! But this 1962 Austin Healy Sebring Sprite, that once raced in a team that included Sir Stirling Moss, isn't in a fit state. But the guys have a plan to get this car back on the racetrack and Sir Stirling Moss back in the driving seat. Fuzz begins work in the garage whilst Tim goes in search of the original engine, and also finding time along the way to have a sit down with the racing legend himself. Will the Sprite be ready in time for Sir Stirling Moss to take it out for a spin? The guys also come across a supercar that's begging to be taken back to the swinging '60s, the Jaguar E-type. But the car's owner Mick is suffering from osteoporosis and has lost all hope that his beloved car will ever be back to its full glory. But Tim and Fuzz are working with Mick's family in secret to restore the car and give Mick a brilliant surprise. But when they discover it's a back to metal restoration this car looks like it's going to be more of a head-ache than a head-turner. Other cars festering away waiting for the guy's attention are Tim's all-time favourite: the Audi Quattro Turbo, the 3 wheeled 1934 Morgan F4, a retro 1982 Mk1 GTI and a 1995 Nissan Skyline GTR. So start up those engines, as Tim and Fuzz return this month for the ultimate car show with a heart.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Born to Summer, queen of a powerful pride, timid lion cub Kio enters a world where every lesson comes at a potential price. One day he may rule a kingdom of his own, but first he must learn to survive. When a buffalo hunt ends in tragedy, Kio gets his first glimpse at how unpredictable life on the savannah can be. As he slowly grows braver, each new challenge pushes him further from the safety of the pride until one solo adventure brings him directly into the path of the pride's greatest enemy: the buffalo.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: It is believed the Hadza people have lived in Tanzania's Great Rift Valley for tens of thousands of years, and they've maintained their hunter-gatherer way of life for just as long. Adventurer and YouTuber Eva zu Beck visits the Hadza and attempts to learn their superskills. First, she hunts with the men using homemade bows and arrows. Then she forages with the women, collecting baobab fruit and digging for tubers using sticks as shovels. On her final day at the Hadza camp, Eva must combine what she's learned to subsist for a full 24 hours on her own in the Tanzanian bush. But going it alone is much harder than she anticipates, and Eva realizes that for the Hazda, survival isn't meant to be a solitary endeavor.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: A new season of Airport Security Colombia and things are busy for the Anti-Narcotics Police as they try to stop their country's most infamous export; cocaine. The task is not easy, and in this episode, they must figure out if a man is smuggling drugs inside hair products. The drama never stops when smugglers risks their life injesting capsules filled with drugs like in the heart-breaking story of a mother who would risk it all for her kids.

programme.title: Airport Security: Brazil
programme.desc: Federal Police at Sao Paolo International Airport work 24-7 to stop illegal activity. Their main threat: cocaine smuggling. Police arrest a woman carrying a load of small purses packed cocaine, but she claims she's innocent. When the agents bring in her boyfriend, she erupts in anger. Agents uncover 3 kilos of cocaine disguised as bleaching powder. A woman hides cocaine in her undergarments, but she may be carrying more elsewhere.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Innocent lives are lost when civilian planes inadvertently become targets, but each incident teaches us vital lessons about how to better protect commercial airliners from the heat of war. Charred wreckage in the Sinai Desert is all that's left of a Russian passenger plane. A Korean 747 plunges into the sea and Soviet officials soon admit to shooting it down. And, when a commercial airliner is blown out of Ukrainian airspace, investigators face geo-political roadblocks at every turn.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: In 1996, on departure of a Birgenair Flight, the pilot ignores vital information given by a junior crew member before smashing into the ocean. The data recorder reveals the confusing sound of multiple alarms. The plane was giving conflicting information as tubes that measured airspeed had been blocked by insect nests. But disaster could have been averted if the crew had heeded warning signs even before the plane lifted off.

programme.title: 9/11 Reunited
programme.desc: Three men in the World Trade Center's north tower were heading up in an elevator when the first plane hit their building. In the elevator with them is one of the World Trade Center's window cleaners, and when they became trapped, he took the lead and hacked their way out, allowing them all to escape. After 25 years, they reunite to thank the window cleaner for the lives they have gone on to live. When the second plane crashes into the south tower, falling debris gravely injures a woman on her way to work. A bystander stays with her in the street and wills her to stay conscious, protecting her from a stampede of fleeing people. He calls frantically for an ambulance to stop, and miraculously, one does. Meeting for the first time since 9/11, Debbie shows Stefan how far she's come and tells him the impact his actions have had on her life.

programme.title: 9/11 Reunited
programme.desc: First responders rushed to the scene after hijacked planes crashed into the twin towers on 9/11. Kevin, a firefighter, and Al, a paramedic, are right under the south tower when it collapses. Al miraculously survives unhurt and finds a badly injured Kevin. Al stabilized Kevin and carried him to a place of safety. Meeting for the first time since, Al fills in the gaps of Kevin's memory, and Kevin thanks him for saving his life. When a third plane struck the Pentagon, Lt. Col. Marilyn Wills led five colleagues to a window, which they kicked open. At ground level, Navy SEAL Craig urged them to jump. He caught Marilyn as she fell, moments before she lost consciousness from smoke inhalation. Meeting for the first time since, Marilyn finally thanks Craig for saving her life, while Craig reminds her that they both played a part in saving lives.

programme.title: 9/11 Reunited
programme.desc: When the south tower collapsed on September 11, firefighter Bill was trapped in the north tower. There, he met NYPD officer John. As they worked together to evacuate people, the two talked about their families. But when the north tower also collapsed, John was killed. After 25 years, Bill meets John's wife and two sons to share John's final moments and tell them he was thinking of his family until the very end. Port Authority officer John McLoughlin was trapped and critically injured but miraculously survived the collapse of both towers. Retired firefighter Scott and NYPD officer John Busching spent hours helping dig him out of the rubble. Twenty-five years later, they reunite as John thanks the men who saved his life and honors the first responders who made the ultimate sacrifice on 9/11.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Abandoned structures and machinery on an island near Antarctica point to brief human settlements. Disturbing noises heard by foreign diplomats in Cuba set off research on a possible global psychological phenomenon. Mysterious rubber-like slabs from Indonesia appear on European beaches. A strange stone pattern found in the waters of Florida's Dry Tortugas National Park reveals a long-lost island.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Colonial-era shipwrecks lead researchers to one of the greatest vessels in the Age of Exploration; invasive ant species drive volunteers to explore haunted military structures. Intriguing shipwrecks and dark underwater tunnels take divers back in time; massive stone disks found on a tropical island reveal a unique trading system.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden beneath seas, sands and stone, ancient medicine comes back into view. Off the coast of Italy, a Roman shipwreck preserves a sealed medical chest containing tablets and tinctures that mirror remedies still recognized today, including treatments for eye disease. In the Levant, poppy-shaped jars point to the world's earliest known use of opium, raising questions about healing, pain relief and post-mortem ritual. Far earlier, deep within the caves of Borneo, a 31,000-year-old skeleton bearing a carefully healed leg amputation reveals advanced anatomical knowledge, long-term care, and surgical planning once thought impossible in the Stone Age. Together, these discoveries uncover a medical sophistication far deeper — and far older — than once imagined.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Across the ancient world, healing often relied on forces unseen. Roman scholars recorded spoken incantations believed to shield the body from malaria, revealing faith in the power of words themselves. In China, the Longmen Grottoes preserve an extraordinary stone-carved medical record that lists remedies made from human hair, animal dung and other unlikely ingredients. Meanwhile, in medieval Poland, archaeologists uncover fossilized squid tails placed in graves, hinting at protective rituals or medicinal symbolism now long forgotten. From spoken spells to carved cures and ritual objects, these clues uncover a world where medicine, magic and belief were deeply entwined.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: In the south, Bjørn gets both work and frustration from nature, when he first have to help a car with frozen fuel, and then the road closes because of when reindeers which is close to extinction is hanging out close to the road. Thord works as a maniac to keep the trucks moving and the road open. In the north, they have to save a truck with fish, a tractor in a house and a dumper that has lost his back axle in steep and icy hills.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: At Toronto Pearson International Airport, the sub-zero temperatures push the largest de-icing station in the world to its limits, as snow and freezing ice delay take offs. On the apron, it's a race to free up frozen cargo doors and water pipes. And the team have their hands full with an injured flight attendant, irate passengers and a trespasser in one of the most dangerous areas of the airport.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Fire crews race to a plane with faulty brakes, cargo vanishes, and passengers refuse to check bags. Wildlife teams deploy eagles and pyrotechnics to clear the runways, while mechanics battle to keep aircraft flight-ready. As problems unfold behind the scenes at Toronto International Airport, multiple teams fight to keep flights on schedule.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam attracts 24 million tourists every year. The capital is one of Europe's leading tourist destinations. Visitors come to Amsterdam not only for the Rijksmuseum or its 165 picturesque canals, but many also for its 165 coffeeshops. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran assist an American tourist who has fallen ill after using soft drugs. At the Ticket & Service department, Alexandra makes a game of guessing which country travelers come from. In the Lost & Found department, staff member Gusta searches for a missing backpack belonging to an American tourist. Tourists from the United Kingdom arrive at Amsterdam Central Station by high-speed train. At the dedicated UK Terminal, the team races against the clock to ensure the train to London departs on time.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Leaping through windows, hoops or narrow gaps can look very cool if done right. But when done wrong, its just embarrassing for everyone involved. And sometimes a costly exercise. Running up a slope can be tricky and for some reason certain people think doing it semi-clothed will be more effective. When you throw in other factors like water, mud and a steep incline, the likelihood of success is reduced even further.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: For more than five decades the US government has refused to discuss UFOs, but now, Navy pilots tell of seeing mysterious objects tracking their fighter jets – vehicles unlike anything they've ever seen before; top-secret Naval videos are leaked that captivate the world. Government officials, led by former U.S. Senator Harry Reid, demand an investigation. At long last, it looks like the truth about UFOs may finally be revealed.

programme.title: UFOs: Investigating the Unknown
programme.desc: For more than five decades the US government has refused to discuss UFOs, but now, Navy pilots tell of seeing mysterious objects tracking their fighter jets – vehicles unlike anything they've ever seen before; top-secret Naval videos are leaked that captivate the world. programme.title: Break It Down
programme.desc: While the ingenuity, skill, logistics and sheer hard work that are required to construct massive structures and state-of-the-art machines is well-documented, what is less well-known is that the same amount of effort is often required to deconstruct these creations. This docu-series follows the crews of engineers and deconstruction specialists as they breakdown these buidings and machines so that they can be recycled. Among the many stories on offer are those of a demolition team working against the clock to bring down an unstable and unsafe bridge; the difficulties faced in breaking up a building that was intended to be impenetrable: a prison; the potential recycling opportunities in a yard full of scrap locomotives; and what to do with the valuable wreckages of Porsche cars.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: The UK's engineering wonders revealed: including innovative electric flying machines, ingenious skyscrapers, the secrets of London's Tower Bridge, a 57 billion pound railway and a mega-stadium with a surprising historical twist.

programme.title: Engineering Europe
programme.desc: Explore the engineering wonders of Europe's northernmost region, from Iceland's epic lava-defying barriers to Finland's record-breaking vertical factory. This spectacular journey uncovers the Nordic's boldest builds including the construction of the world's largest wooden city and a Swedish ferry that doesn't just sail—it flies.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Lightning bolts cause construction mayhem whenever they strike buildings. All over the world, cities are sinking for very different reasons, and cooling towers are collapsing. A Mexico City metro train and many bridges in India all fall down. While in Dallas, an unlucky demolition becomes a cousin of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and a social media sensation. Regular people show off their MacGyver skills prompting the question: genius or harebrained?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: An Italian supermarket under construction drastically collapsesy. Amusement parks become a lot less amusing when fires break out; India's tunnel workers are trapped in a catastrophic collapse; Canada's light rail fails over and over again; and a stadium loses its lid to a hurricane. Plus, there's a look at how home construction's been misled by lead.

programme.title: Atlas of Cursed Places
programme.desc: Sam heads to the Mountain State to investigate the curse of the Mothman, a winged cryptid whose presence signals disaster. But, in a dangerous turn of events, Sam finds himself embroiled in a tangled web of disasters, population poisoning, physical threats and dirty politics in West Virginia.

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: Scotland's Livingston UFO, Norway's Hessdalen Lights and Portugal's Castelo de Bode Dam encounter. On 17th June, 1977 a young Portuguese pilot comes face to face with a large unknown object at 5,000 feet. He observes it for a few seconds before it vanishes into the clouds. Suddenly, his magnetic compass spins wildly and his aircraft goes into an uncontrolled nose dive. In the early 1980's hundreds of mysterious lights are witnessed flying through the Hessdalen Valley in Norway. Scientist Erling Strand from Ostfold University College is keen to investigate so he sets up camp in the valley. He is amazed at the spectacular lights and after capturing them on film, discovers something intriguing. In 1979 a Scottish forester describes an incredible encounter with a UFO in a lonely clearing. He falls down unconscious and when he comes to, finds cuts on his legs and tears on his trousers. The police launch the UK's first ever criminal investigation into a UFO encounter.

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: Rendlesham Revisited, Mussolini's Secret UFO Files and The Swedish Mora UFO Photos. Around 3am on Dec 26th 1980, US Air Force personnel venture into the forest to investigate strange lights. Two nights later, similar lights are seen again as the Deputy Base Commander makes his way through the forest with a team. A set of unknown files describing a UFO sighting in Venice in 1936 are anonymously sent to an Italian Ufologist. The documents within purport to be a secret government report of the UFO sighting and an extraordinary government cover up that followed. The documents state the cover up was ordered by the Italian dictator, Mussolini, who was convinced the sighting was of some sort of advanced European technology. On 15th September 1952, 20 year-old Nils Frost is cycling home late one night. As he arrives at his house he sees two bright glowing lights suspended above the forest nearby.

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: Gravediggers, witches and goat riders are the focus of BLOODY TALES - DARK ARTS where Tudor historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley venture into the unknown. Were the gravediggers of a town called Frankenstein guilty of spreading the plague with powders made from dead corpses? Why was a respectable surgeon accused of being a gang leader of devil worshipping thieves, and how did a small Basque village get caught up in the biggest witch hunt in Spanish history?

programme.title: Bloody Tales of Europe
programme.desc: What links a Scottish National hero, a Danish Viking Warrior and a Nazi SS Officer? All three experienced unusual and barbaric deaths by execution. In BLOODY TALES - EXECUTIONS, Tudor historian Dr Suzannah Lipscomb and journalist Joe Crowley team up to investigate three extraordinary stories. Did it take three attempts to execute Amon Goeth, the Nazi commander of a labour camp in World War 2; was the Viking Ragnar Lodbrok really killed by a pit full of snakes? And did William Wallace's punishment of death by hanging drawing and quartering, really fit the crime?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: December 29, 1972. Eastern Airlines Flight 401 is coming in for a landing in Miami. On the crews instrument panel, one of the three green lights confirming the planes landing gear is down and locked remains unlit. Captain Robert Loft decides to have the auto pilot fly the plane in a holding pattern while he and his crew work to fix the problem. Flying at 2,000 feet all four men in the cockpit focus their attention on the troublesome bulb. None of them notice that the plane is slowly descending to the ground, until its too late. The brand new L-1011 slams into the remote swampland of the Florida Everglades. Miraculously 77 people survive the initial crash. Investigators determine that the plane was mechanically sound, and that its auto pilot was working. So why had the state of the art jetliner fallen from the sky? The clues would lead investigators to a very troubling cause.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Radio silence between pilots and air traffic controllers can mean many different things, but only the physical evidence can reveal the true story. Three shocking cases send investigators hunting for answers. A Greek airliner goes rogue and crashes outside Athens. A China Airlines 747 disappears from radar and the culprit is discovered on the ocean floor. And, when controllers lose contact with a private jet, fighter planes scramble to intervene.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Winter brings chaos to roads around the world. In the United States, men and women brave treacherous roads to rescue stranded drivers and recover heavy-duty wrecks. Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc! is a 2-part compilation series that tells the stories of the most dangerous recoveries, largest payloads and harrowing rescues featured in Ice Road Rescue (Norway). Tow operators face brutal weather and terrifying situations as they rescue everything from cargo worth thousands of dollars to people to the burned-out shells of semi-trucks. Each episode shows the skill, dedication and courage of the operators who risk it all to keep the roads open.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: Akashinga: The Brave Ones
programme.desc: With many of Africa's key species, including elephants, heading toward extinction, Akashinga is a radical, new and highly effective weapon against poaching. Founded in Zimbabwe by former Australian special forces soldier and anti-poaching leader Damien Mander, the women-only team of rangers, drawn from the abused and marginalized, is revolutionizing the way animals are protected, communities are empowered — and its members' own lives are being transformed. Mander's innovative approach to conservation calls for community buy-in rather than full-on armed assault against poachers: If a community understands the economic benefits of preserving animals, then it will eliminate poaching without an armed struggle.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden in coins, bones and ancient texts, the struggle to defeat disease spans continents and millennia. In England, hundreds of angel coins uncover a royal healing ritual once believed to cure the "king's evil" through the monarch's touch, revealing why kings risked contact with the sick. In India, a 4,000-year-old skull bearing unmistakable signs of leprosy offers rare insight into a disease that shaped human history and the lengths healers went to combat it. In Egypt, papyri filled with diagnoses and prescriptions combine with newly examined skeletal evidence to suggest one of the earliest known attempts to surgically treat cancer. Together, these discoveries reveal how belief, authority and experimentation shaped the earliest fights against humanity's most feared illnesses.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Across history, healing has taken many surprising forms. Medieval Europe turns to barber-surgeons, who cut hair, draw blood and perform surgery amid plague and conflict, laying the groundwork for professional medicine. In Elizabethan England, physicians trained in astrology consulted the heavens, believing planetary movements held the key to diagnosis and cure. Centuries earlier in ancient India, an extraordinary innovator defied social taboos to advance surgery, develop specialized tools, and expand anatomical knowledge through Ayurvedic principles. From battlefield care to star-guided medicine and pioneering surgery, these practices uncover the diverse foundations of medical science.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Amid civil war in 14th century Mongol-controlled China, scholar and strategist Liu Bowen lends his talents to a dynasty on the rise. But his name is also remembered for a more mysterious talent: fortune-telling with what some say is frightening precision. A series of cryptic prophecies earns him the moniker of China's "Nostradamus." In Ancient Rome, Julius Caesar receives a warning that his life is in danger. The prophecy, uttered by an Etruscan soothsayer, is divined through the strange art of haruspicy. Caesar ignores the omen at his own peril. Amongst the hills of the Scottish Lowlands, the influential Erskine family becomes haunted by a mysterious prophecy, presaging and inflicting countless moments of tragedy and heartbreak.

programme.title: Decoding History's Prophecies
programme.desc: Edgar Cayce, known as the "sleeping prophet," claims to use hypnotic states to heal the sick and see the future. Cayce is alleged to have predicted the Wall Street Crash of 1929, the Second World War, and the assassination of JFK. His aura stokes fear around his most frightening prediction of all — the end of the world. In Ancient Greece, the Oracle of Delphi is the premier prophesier of the ancient world. The words of this Pythia, channeled down from Apollo, go on to shape human history, foretelling the rise and fall of empires. And in 19th-century France, radical occult thinker Eliphas Lévi draws upon early mysticism to develop a spiritual doctrine. Branded as a devil worshiper by the public, the truth of his life's work is even stranger.

programme.title: Naming the Dead
programme.desc: Across the United States, more than 50,000 bodies remain unidentified—unmourned, unnamed, but not forgotten. "Naming The Dead", a riveting new six-part investigative series from National Geographic, brings these untold stories to light. The series follows the groundbreaking work of the DNA Doe Project, a trailblazing nonprofit that uses genetic genealogy to help law enforcement crack the country's most confounding cold cases.

programme.title: Atlas of Cursed Places
programme.desc: Sam heads to the Mountain State to investigate the curse of the Mothman, a winged cryptid whose presence signals disaster. But, in a dangerous turn of events, Sam finds himself embroiled in a tangled web of disasters, population poisoning, physical threats and dirty politics in West Virginia.

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: In 1946, nearly a thousand strange objects are seen flying through the skies of Sweden. Despite many being witnessed crashing into lakes, and a thorough government investigation, not a single piece of debris was ever found. In 1982, a Portuguese Air Force pilot is circled by a UFO at over 1500 meters for nearly 30 minutes. The incident launched one of the biggest UFO investigations in Portuguese military history. A journalist uncovers an extraordinary UFO "mass-sighting" of strange luminous phenomena in a remote Italian village.

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: 8th September 1970: the height of the Cold War. American pilot Capt. Schaffner is scrambled to intercept an unidentified target over the North Sea and disappears without trace. When his aircraft is discovered, the cockpit is closed but his body has vanished. In 2004, in a small fishing village on the island of Sicily, a series of unexplained incidents take place… one after another. A fisherman witnesses a mysterious, unidentified, red light that flies up from the water. Other local residents also report UFOs sightings in the area. But the UFO sightings were just the start of a bizarre and frightening set of events that took place in and around the village of Canneto di Caronia. RAF Pilot, Sargent Hughes encounters an UFO on a routine training flight over Germany in 1952. Despite flying with three other planes he is the only one to witness the object. His colleagues mock him and dismiss his sighting as a flight of fancy, as a joke they paint a flying saucer on his aeroplane saying "Saucer Sam".

programme.title: UFO Europe: Untold Stories
programme.desc: On August 18, 1985, 4 civilian pilots are flying back from an air show when they notice a silver missile shaped object coming towards them and passing underneath their plane. They turn around and try to keep up with the object but it is too fast for them. They report the sighting, but no conclusive answers were found. On January 8th, 1981, a man working in a field reported seeing a strange object land in his field. Shortly afterwards, the object took off. He noticed marks on the ground where he thought the object had landed and decided to report what he had seen. Despite investigations, no definite explanation was reached. From late 1989 to Spring 1990, thousands of people across Belgium reported sightings of 3 lights in a triangular formation, moving across the sky. The lights were seen over cities and in the countryside, and even sparked a scramble of Air Force F-16 jets to investigate.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: SAIL Amsterdam is the largest nautical event in the world, held in the capital once every five years. Around 800 historic ships and impressive tall ships sail along the IJ River past Amsterdam Central Station. Amsterdam Central Station staff expects an additional 150,000 passengers, making it one of the busiest days of the year. To ensure the enormous influx of visitors doesn't lead to dangerous congestion, station manager René and safety coordinator Bas oversee crowd control. They have to pull out all the stops, especially after the fireworks show ends in the evening. For the Safety & Service team, it's all hands on deck. Menno and Baran are busy dealing with alcohol-related incidents of collapse and aggression.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: HSI agents in Miami discover a shipment of fish found to contain 37 kilos of cocaine worth almost 2 million dollars. Meanwhile, San Diego CBP officers disrupt multiple human smuggling attempts at the San Ysidro border involving 8 individuals in 3 different vehicles. And CBP agriculture specialists in Atlanta search passengers to stop the spread of destructive invasive species stemming from prohibited food items.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Since ancient times, humans have had tangled bonds with snakes. Across the Americas and Australia, diverse habitats host venomous vipers and powerful constrictors, each evolved to fill their niche. In the Americas, over 30 rattlesnake species curb rodent populations, sustaining ecosystems. Meanwhile, Australia's coral reefs hide even deadlier sea snakes and the elusive, extremely venomous coastal taipan. From lush forests to desert sands and ocean depths, these continents harbor a hidden world of some of the most lethal, fascinating and secretive serpents.

programme.title: Asia's Weirdest
programme.desc: Asia's natural world is full of weird wildlife. The largest continent on Earth has more than its fair share of peculiar plants and abnormal animals, and this documentary series delves deep into its wild landscapes to reveal some of the strangest species on offer. Expect the unexpected in places like no other, as the series heads to extraordinary locations including the rugged islands of Indonesia and the grasslands of Mongolia.

programme.title: Living Edens
programme.desc: Born of a violent explosion more than two million years ago, the Ngorongoro Crater is one of the true wonders of the world. Today the ancient crater is a microcosm of African life. The relentless daily cycle of life and death within the crater's grasslands, wetlands, lakes and forests maintains a delicate balance for the lions, hyenas, cheetahs, jackals, vultures, servals and wildebeest that live there.

programme.title: An Elephant's World
programme.desc: Confronted by fire, famine, predators, and poachers, three elephant families overcome adversity in ways that feel almost human in nature. This documentary will follow the journeys of elephant herds in Kenya, India, and Mali as they migrate towards food and safety, using knowledge shared over generations. As we look into the minds of elephants, we see that their unique abilities to communicate, educate, and sympathize provide them with the necessary skills to survive. Yet, despite the strength and intelligence of these majestic creatures, humans are causing elephant populations to plummet around the world.

programme.title: Amur Tiger: Secret Kingdom
programme.desc: Using a combination of remote cameras, long lens and drone filming, and told across the seasons, the Secret Kingdom of the Amur Tiger takes you deep inside this remote kingdom to unveil long held secrets about these shy and elusive hunters; how they navigate and co-exist along secret corridors, use secret messaging to communicate to one another, hunt their prey and exploit the seasons, with the ultimate ambition of finding a partner and bringing new life in to this world.

programme.title: Monsters of the Wild: Creepy Crawlers
programme.desc: Mother Nature…creator of breathtaking beauty. And it seems there's no end to her evolutionary inspirations…or perhaps? Twisted imagination. From cunning assassins, mysterious mating rituals, and strange parenting to nautical oddballs and toxic terrors. We

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular. But look closer and the desert reveals a SECRET WORLD of INTRIGUE… surprising stories of survival, epic perseverance… and things you've never seen before. All of America's deserts provide something… a hidden bounty for those who know where to find it… and how to use it. Title Final Yes

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Surfing Hippos - Gabon's Jungle Beach
programme.desc: On the western edge of Central Africa, where the Congo rainforest meets the Atlantic Ocean, lies one of the planet's last great wilderness frontiers: the coast of Gabon. Here, forest elephants, hippos, antelopes, monkeys and countless other animals emerge from the jungle onto remote beaches, drawn by food, minerals, shelter and the sea itself. Some hippos even venture into the surf. By night, the shoreline becomes a cradle of life, shaped by ancient rhythms that have endured for millennia, but this fragile paradise is under threat. Ocean currents now carry plastic waste to shores once considered untouched.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate look at the mountains of North and South America. Over 9,000 miles long, a series of mountain chains run from Alaska to the Rockies to the Andes. These mountains are right here in our backyard but we barely know them. Theyre still an untamed wilderness with creatures youve never seen before.

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography brings us on an epic yet intimate journey through America's Coasts... among the most diverse and dramatic shores on earth. Shaped by three great oceans, America's coastline twists well over 100,000 miles almost from POLE to POLE… the only contiguous landmass to encompass nearly every latitude. We travel from the cold, deep Pacific, to the idyllic warm paradise of the Caribbean sea… from the icy waters of the Arctic, to the southern ocean at the end of the world. America's shores are home to extraordinary life… and awe-inspiring spectacles that could only be found here!

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate look at the forests of the Americas. With the biggest latitude of any of the continents, the Americas boast the greatest variety of forests in the world: from the tropical rain forest of the Amazon, to the boreal forest in the far north. They may look like Edens, but living in these American forests is the ultimate test of survival theyre exposed to brutally harsh seasonal extremes of floods, freezing, and fire. The forests rights here in our backyards are also secret worlds with creatures both rare and familiar doing extraordinary things to survive. These are dramatic intimate scenes of Americas iconic animals as youve never seen them before.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: American Amazon
programme.desc: Secret Rivers. Take a journey into the secret wilderness of North America. Under the spell of legendary Southern waterways, follow the pulse of water as it tumbles from precipitous Appalachian highlands.

programme.title: Crocodiles Revealed
programme.desc: There's much more to a crocodile than terrifying jaws and spectacular ambush attacks. As one of the stealthiest predators in the natural world, more than half its life is spent hidden, underwater. We join a dive expedition in the Okavango Delta to discover its true - and unexpected nature.

We travel from the cold, deep Pacific, to the idyllic warm paradise of the Caribbean sea… from the icy waters of the Arctic, to the southern ocean at the end of the world. America's shores are home to extraordinary life… and awe-inspiring spectacles that could only be found here!

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate journey through America's deserts. Everything in the desert lives and dies at the mercy of water. Dry, inhospitable wilderness, they are among the harshest, most extreme environments on the planet. Wind and water sculpt these thirst-lands into natural monuments… as unique as they are spectacular. But look closer and the desert reveals a SECRET WORLD of INTRIGUE… surprising stories of survival, epic perseverance… and things you've never seen before. All of America's deserts provide something… a hidden bounty for those who know where to find it… and how to use it. Title Final Yes

programme.title: Untamed Americas
programme.desc: Stunning HD cinematography produces an epic yet intimate look at the forests of the Americas. With the biggest latitude of any of the continents, the Americas boast the greatest variety of forests in the world: from the tropical rain forest of the Amazon, to the boreal forest in the far north. They may look like Edens, but living in these American forests is the ultimate test of survival theyre exposed to brutally harsh seasonal extremes of floods, freezing, and fire. The forests rights here in our backyards are also secret worlds with creatures both rare and familiar doing extraordinary things to survive. These are dramatic intimate scenes of Americas iconic animals as youve never seen them before.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines: Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: National Geographic Wild. A nation of more than 100 million people on a collection of over 7,600 islands all set in the warm emerald seas of the Pacific Ocean, the Philippines is a land of sparkling wonder and contrasts.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.
